subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` adopt fixed 1 MiB `AGENTS.md` and 8 MiB root-memory read ceilings that leave oversized workspace files untouched for manual repair?
rationale: The caps intentionally change the repair outcome for existing large workspaces; source review can establish safety mechanics but cannot choose the repository’s long-term compatibility and operator-support contract.

options.title: Accept capped safe reads
options.body: Approve the stated ceilings once exact-head proof confirms both race-preservation paths leave user data recoverable.

options.title: Choose different limits or operator flow
options.body: Retain the bounded-read design but require different thresholds or a clearer doctor recovery path before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept capped safe reads
recommendation.body: Approve the stated ceilings once exact-head proof confirms both race-preservation paths leave user data recoverable.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest commits implement the final preservation policy and this person is assigned in the PR timeline.
